commit.message:
Use loopback address for local communication

`InetAddress.getLocalHost()` may select a non-loopback address, whose
traffic may be subject to filtering rules.  This can cause the test to
time out (since the receiver doesn't get the packets), causing the test
to fail.

Since all communication in these tests is local, this patch makes use of
`InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress()` instead.
